name: Noam Bettan
description: '''Noam Bettan'''{{efn|{{langx|he|נועם בתן}}, {{IPA|he|ˈnoʔam beˈtan|pron}}}} (born 5 March 1998) is an Israeli singer and songwriter. In 2026, he won the 12th season of the Israeli singing competition ''[[Rising Star (Israeli TV series)|Rising Star]]'' (HaKokhav HaBa). He represented {{Esccnty|Israel|y=2026}} in the [[Eurovision Song Contest 2026]] with the song "[[Michelle (Noam Bettan song)|Michelle]]", finishing in second place.
